headline: Stage 2 screening is complete: all three Qwen3 14B artefacts are committed in this repository. The full run reports 3/24 majority-correct items (rate 0.1250, Wilson interval [0.0434, 0.3100]). The separate sliced run shows every correct item is L1 (3/12) and L7 produced 0 correct samples out of 120. These are automated screening results, not human legal verification. The L7 zero is unexplained and must be investigated before any larger run. G5, G6 and G7 are unchanged.
completed: Stage 2 step 1: authored a 24-item candidate set in the Phase A schema with provenance.verified = false (data/lexuq_target_candidates_v1.jsonl)
per-item source record with BNS-to-IPC section pairs and an explicit authority level per source (runs/phaseG_candidate_sources_v1.json)
candidate-contract validation of the whole set via jurisuq/target/candidates.py (no alternative validation path)
the screen's generation guard was exercised and refused a real provider without --allow-generation
the mock plumbing check was run end to end against the real 24-item file and recorded as non-evidence
the real target-yield screen was run locally by the principal investigator on Qwen3 14B via LM Studio: 24 items x 10 samples = 240 generations (reported, artifact not yet in the repository)
the screen now emits a per-slice yield breakdown; before this change an aggregate rate could not show whether the L7 arm produced any correct majority answer, which is the one question G7 depends on

candidate_yield_screening.measured: 24 items x 10 samples; full run 3/24 majority-correct (0.1250, [0.0434, 0.3100]) with 34/240 correct samples; sliced run 3/24 with L1 3/12 and L7 0/12 (0/120 correct samples)

earlier_blocked_attempt_retained.reason: the screen requires a generator; a real generation attempt was made and failed

attempt.provider: openai-compatible client pointed at the configured LM Studio endpoint http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1
attempt.outcome: RuntimeError: generation request failed after 3 tries: HTTPConnectionPool(host='127.0.0.1', port=1234): Max retries exceeded ... Connection refused
attempt.note: No paid endpoint was contacted. No API key is present in this environment and the sandbox has no outbound access to the hosted providers.

consequences: no majority answers, therefore no majority_correct, therefore no correctness classes
no yield rate and no items_needed projection from measured data

gate_g7_evaluation.reason: G7 requires a stored run with measured correctness classes on both sides of an evaluated slice. A 24-item screen report, even once added, is a yield estimate, not an evaluated partition: it carries no detector fields, no uncertainty scores and no calibration, so it cannot enter the Section 21.2 grid. G7 is unchanged.
gate_g7_evaluation.must_not_be_read_as: a fresh G7 evaluation, a pass, or an improvement

human_legal_review.reason: the source checks in this environment are machine-assisted and were made by the same system that authored the items; they are not qualified legal approval

l7_investigation.question: why did the L7 arm produce no correct answer at all?
l7_investigation.not_established: item difficulty, a wrong gold label, model failure to apply the transition, or the model taking the designed IPC trap
l7_investigation.blocked_by: neither committed report retains per-item records, so the failure mode cannot be classified without a small diagnostic run that writes them
l7_investigation.remains_pending: human legal review of the L7 gold labels

observations_for_review: The Section 21.2 grid and G7 are defined over evaluated partitions of a stored run; a candidate item set with no answers cannot enter that grid at all, so authoring items cannot by itself move G7.

The Bill version of the BNS (as introduced) numbered punishment for murder as s.101 and punishment for culpable homicide as s.103. The enacted Act renumbers these to s.103 and s.105. Items here cite the enacted numbering. This is a documented source-confusion risk for any reviewer using Bill-era tables.

for cruelty_by_husband the official BNS-to-IPC correspondence table was read only up to Chapter V in this environment, so the BNS 85 <- IPC 498A pairing rests on section titles plus the standard published mapping and needs human confirmation

no_network_during_cleanup.note: no model was called and no API was contacted while preparing this record; the screen figures were supplied by the principal investigator and were checked only arithmetically

reported_screen.observation_source: The report is committed in this repository at the path above (merged in PR #7). Its field values were read directly from the file while preparing this record.
reported_screen.why_not_recorded_verbatim: Superseded: the generated report is committed as its own JSON artifact, so this record summarises it rather than duplicating it. The artifact is authoritative if the two disagree.
reported_screen.generator: Qwen3 14B, run locally through LM Studio
reported_screen.provider: openai-compatible client against a local endpoint

corroboration.method: the reported figures were recomputed with this repository's own code, without regenerating anything

checks.via: jurisuq.target.yield_report on 3 correct and 21 incorrect records
jurisuq.target.items_needed(0.125, 15, 0.95) with the planning parameters in configs/phase_g_target.json
34/240; the report's own sample-level count is not in this repository, so this is an arithmetic consistency check only

corroboration.what_corroboration_does_not_establish: that the file exists, what the model actually answered, or that any individual item is labelled correctly. It shows the reported summary is internally consistent with this codebase's methods.

reported_screen.next_step: Review the full and sliced report artifacts separately; retain human legal review as outstanding.
reported_screen.note: This report has no per-slice breakdown; it predates the change to scripts/41 that added yield_by_slice. That is why the separate sliced run was made.

per_slice_question.question: did the L7 arm produce any correct majority answer?
per_slice_question.answer: No. L7 produced 0 majority-correct items out of 12, and 0 correct samples out of 120. All 3 correct majority answers are L1.
per_slice_question.not_answerable_from: runs/phaseG_screen_qwen3_14b_full.json, which carries no yield_by_slice block and no per-item records
per_slice_question.scope_limit: this answers the question for the sliced screening run only. It does not establish legal correctness, and it does not explain the result.
per_slice_question.why_it_matters: G7 requires both correctness classes on every evaluated slice. The frozen evidence already has L7 at 0 correct of 100; the screen now shows the same pattern on new candidate items, so a larger run of these items cannot be expected to create an L7 correct class.
per_slice_question.distinct_from_frozen_result: the frozen Phase G finding (0 correct of 100 L7 items) and this screening result (0 of 12 candidate L7 items) are separate measurements on different item sets and must not be merged.

affordability.step: Stage 2: 'decide from the measured items_needed whether a full run is affordable'

projection.derived_from: the aggregate rate of 0.125, which L7 contributes nothing to

affordability.reasoning: The 172-item projection is an aggregate figure that assumes a constant rate of 0.125 across items. The sliced run shows that rate is carried entirely by L1 and that L7 yields 0.00, from which items_needed cannot project at all. A 1,720-generation run would therefore buy more L1 items and could not be expected to create the L7 correct class G7 needs.
affordability.note: a planning judgement from measured figures, not a gate and not a threshold change

sliced_screen.relationship_to_full_run: a SEPARATE run of the same 24 items, not the same run re-reported. The two agree on majority-correct items (3/24) and differ on individual correct samples (34 vs 32). Do not pool, average, or substitute one for the other.
sliced_screen.settles: whether the L7 arm produced any correct majority answer in this screening run: it did not, and it produced no correct sample either
sliced_screen.does_not_settle: why. Zero yield at both the majority and the sample level is consistent with the model consistently selecting the repealed IPC trap provision, but no per-item records exist in either report to establish that.

smoke_screen.scope: SMOKE TEST - connectivity and report-path check before the long run. Not an evaluation and not a yield estimate.

projection.note: a zero observed rate cannot be projected; a zero would be indistinguishable from an even lower unobserved rate
